paper.title: On Best-Arm Identification with a Fixed Budget in Non-Parametric Multi-Armed Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Best-arm identification with a fixed budget in a general (non-parametric) model D
unmapped: model D is any class of distributions with finite first moments (key examples: all distributions on [0,1], canonical one-parameter exponential families)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a class $\cD$ of distributions over $\R$ with finite first moments, which we refer to as the model $\cD$. ... Therein, the total number $T$ of pulls of the arms is fixed. After these $T$ pulls, a strategy must issue a recommendation $I_T$.

settings.name_in_paper: Best-arm identification with a fixed budget in a general model D (lower bound)
unmapped: model D is any class of distributions with finite first moments
settings.definition_quote: In most of this section, we restrict our attention to generic $K$--armed bandit problems $\unu$, that are such that $\mu_j \ne \mu_k$ for $j \ne k$.

settings.name_in_paper: Fixed-budget BAI in the Bernoulli model B_[1/4,3/4] (lower bound)
settings.definition_quote: consider the model $\cDber$ of Bernoulli distributions $\Ber(p)$ with parameters $p \in [1/4, \, 3/4]$.

symbols.G_SR: min_{1<=r<=K-1} gamma_r * min_{k in A_r} Phi(nu_k, nu_star), with A_r any set of r arms not containing the optimal arm
symbols.Phi: inf_{x in [E(nu'),E(nu)]} {phi*_{nu'}(x) + phi*_{nu}(x)} (Fenchel-Legendre transforms of log-MGFs)

tuning: phase lengths such that N_r/T -> gamma_r > 0 for all r

source.label: th:SR
source.quote: Fix $K\geq 2$ and a model $\cD$. Consider a sequence of successive-rejects strategies, indexed by $T$, such that $N_r/T \to \gamma_r > 0$ as $T \to +\infty$ for all $r \in \{1, \dots, K-1\}$. Let $\unu$ be a bandit problem in $\cD$ with a unique optimal arm and, for each $r$, let $\cA_r$ be a subset of arms of cardinality $r$ that does not contain $a^\star(\unu)$. Then \limsup ... \leq - \min_{1 \leq r \leq K-1} \{ \gamma_r \min_{k \in \cA_r} \Phi(\nu_k,\nu^\star) \}.

results.notes: Bound is on limsup (1/T) ln P(error) <= -G_SR; expressed as exp(-T*G_SR) with limsup notation.

symbols.H_f: min_{2<=k<=K} f(nu_{sigma_k}, nu_star)/k, f any lower bound on Phi, arms sorted by increasing f

tuning: phase lengths l_1 = T/lnbar_K, l_r = T/((K-r+2) lnbar_K)

source.label: cor:SR
source.quote: Fix $K\geq 2$, a model $\cD$, and consider a lower bound $f$ on $\Phi$. The sequence of successive-rejects strategies based on the phase lengths~\eqref{eq:reglengths-ABM10} ensures, that for all bandit problems $\unu$ in $\cD$ with a unique optimal arm, \limsup ... \leq - \frac{1}{\bln K} \min_{2 \leq k \leq K} \frac{f( \nu_{\sigma_{k}}, \nu^\star )}{k}

results.notes: With f = Phi and Lemma (duality), for D = all distributions on [0,1] or exponential families Phi equals the Chernoff-type quantity L (eq. ov_boundSR). With f = Delta_k^2 (Hoeffding, [0,1] model) recovers the ABM10 bound.

symbols.H_Linf: min_{2<=k<=K} L_inf^<(mu_(k), nu_star)/k, with L_inf^<(x,nu) = inf{KL(zeta,nu): zeta in D, E(zeta) < x}

conditions: doubly-indexed sequence of strategies that is consistent, balanced against the worst arm, and cleverly exploits the pruning of suboptimal arms

source.label: th:LB-ABM10
source.quote: Fix a model $\cD$. Consider a doubly-indexed sequence of strategies that is consistent, balanced against the worst arm on $\cD$, and that cleverly exploits the pruning of suboptimal arms on~$\cD$. For all generic bandit problems $\unu$ in $\cD$ with $K \geq 2$ arms, \liminf ... \geq - \min_{2 \leq k \leq K} \frac{\Linfstr(\mu_{(k)},\nu^\star)}{k}.

results.notes: Lower bound on liminf (1/T) ln P(error) expressed as exp(-T*...).

symbols.H_mono: min_{2<=k<=K} min_{2<=j<=k} inf_{x in [mu_(j), mu_(j-1))} {L_sup^>(x,nu_(k))/(j-1) + L_inf^<(x,nu_star)/j}

conditions: sequence of strategies is consistent and monotonous on D

source.label: th:LBmonotone
source.quote: Fix $K \geq 2$ and a normal model $\cD$. Consider a sequence of strategies which is consistent and monotonous on $\cD$. For all generic bandit problems $\unu$ in $\cD$, \liminf ... \geq - \min_{2 \leq k \leq K} \min_{2 \leq j \leq k} \inf_{x \in [\mu_{(j)}, \mu_{(j-1)})} \{ \frac{\Lsupstr(x, \nu_{(k)})}{j-1} + \frac{\Linfstr(x, \nu^\star)}{j} \}.

results.notes: Main lower bound of the paper.

symbols.H_pair: min_{k != a_star} inf_{x in [mu_k, mu_star]} max{L_sup^>(x,nu_k), L_inf^<(x,nu_star)}

source.label: th:LB-conj-GK16
source.quote:
Fix $K \geq 2$ and a model $\cD$. Consider a consistent sequence of strategies on $\cD$. For all generic bandit problems $\unu$ in $\cD$, \liminf ... \geq - \min_{k 
eq a^\star(\unu)} \inf_{x \in [\mu_k, \mu^\star]} \max \{ \Lsupstr(x, 
u_k), \Linfstr(x, 
u^\star) \}.

results.notes: Extends KCG16 two-arm bound to K arms.

bound.regime: along an increasing sequence of budgets T_n

conditions: consistent sequences of strategies on the model
holds for some instance nu (minimax-type), along a subsequence of budgets

source.label: prop:CL16
source.quote: Fix $K \geq 3$ and consider the model $\cDber$ of Bernoulli distributions $\Ber(p)$ with parameters $p \in [1/4, \, 3/4]$. For all consistent sequences of strategies on $\cDber$, there exists an increasing sequence of budgets $(T_n)_{n \geq 1}$ such that \exists \unu in \cDber, \liminf_n \frac{1}{T_n} \ln \P_{\unu}(I_{T_n} \ne a^\star(\unu)) \geq - \frac{30}{\ln K} (\sum_{a \neq a^\star(\unu)} \frac{1}{\Delta_a^2})^{-1}.

results.notes: Asymptotic variant of Carpentier & Locatelli (2016) lower bound with constant improved from 400 to 30.

symbols.H_zeta: sum_{a != a_star} 1/KL(nu_a, zeta_a), for chosen zeta_a in D with E(zeta_a) > mu_star

conditions: bound is on the max of the error probabilities over nu and the alternatives nu^(k) obtained by replacing arm k with zeta_k

source.label: prop:LB-BH
source.quote:
Fix $K \geq 2$, a model $\cD$, and any sequence of strategies. Let $\unu$ be a bandit problem in $\cD$ with a unique optimal arm. Consider, for each $k 
eq a^\star(\unu)$, a distribution $\zeta_k \in \cD$ such that $\Ed(\zeta_k) > \mu^\star$. ... For all $T \geq 1$,  rac{1}{T} \ln \max \{ ... \} \geq - (\sum_{a 
eq a^\star(\unu)}  rac{1}{\KL(
u_a, \zeta_a)})^{-1} -  rac{\ln 4}{T}.

results.notes: Non-asymptotic; lower-bounds the max of error probabilities over a family of instances, not the target error alone. probability field set to expectation as closest (the bound is deterministic on a probability).
